from framework import BlackBoxCase


class TestReleaseReplayJourney(BlackBoxCase):
    def test_release_repeat_replay_and_rejected_consume(self):
        initial_quota = self.client.call("GET", "/quota")
        self.assertEqual(initial_quota.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(initial_quota.body, {"available": 4, "consumed": 0})
        self.assertEqual(initial_quota.body["available"] + initial_quota.body["consumed"], 4)

        created = self.client.call(
            "POST", "/holds", {"units": 2, "key": "ReleaseReplay1"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(created.status, 201)
        hold_id = created.body["id"]
        self.assertEqual(created.body["owner"], "player-a")
        self.assertEqual(created.body["units"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(created.body["key"], "ReleaseReplay1")
        self.assertEqual(created.body["state"], "active")

        created_hold = self.client.call("GET", f"/holds/{hold_id}")
        created_quota = self.client.call("GET", "/quota")
        self.assertEqual(created_hold.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(created_hold.body, created.body)
        self.assertEqual(created_quota.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(created_quota.body, {"available": 2, "consumed": 0})
        self.assertEqual(
            created_quota.body["available"]
            + created_hold.body["units"]
            + created_quota.body["consumed"],
            4,
        )

        released = self.client.call("POST", f"/holds/{hold_id}/release")
        self.assertEqual(released.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(released.body["id"], hold_id)
        self.assertEqual(released.body["state"], "released")
        first_release_hold = self.client.call("GET", f"/holds/{hold_id}")
        first_release_quota = self.client.call("GET", "/quota")
        self.assertEqual(first_release_hold.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(first_release_hold.body, released.body)
        self.assertEqual(first_release_quota.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(first_release_quota.body, {"available": 4, "consumed": 0})
        self.assertEqual(
            first_release_quota.body["available"]
            + first_release_quota.body["consumed"],
            4,
        )

        repeated_release = self.client.call("POST", f"/holds/{hold_id}/release")
        self.assertEqual(repeated_release.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(repeated_release.body, first_release_hold.body)
        repeated_hold = self.client.call("GET", f"/holds/{hold_id}")
        repeated_quota = self.client.call("GET", "/quota")
        self.assertEqual(repeated_hold.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(repeated_quota.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(repeated_hold.body, first_release_hold.body)
        self.assertEqual(repeated_quota.body, first_release_quota.body)
        self.assertEqual(
            repeated_quota.body["available"] + repeated_quota.body["consumed"],
            4,
        )

        replayed = self.client.call(
            "POST", "/holds", {"units": 2, "key": "ReleaseReplay1"}
        )
        self.assertEqual(replayed.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(replayed.body, repeated_hold.body)
        replayed_hold = self.client.call("GET", f"/holds/{hold_id}")
        replayed_quota = self.client.call("GET", "/quota")
        self.assertEqual(replayed_hold.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(replayed_quota.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(replayed_hold.body, repeated_hold.body)
        self.assertEqual(replayed_quota.body, repeated_quota.body)
        self.assertEqual(
            replayed_quota.body["available"] + replayed_quota.body["consumed"],
            4,
        )

        rejected_consume = self.client.call("POST", f"/holds/{hold_id}/consume")
        self.assertEqual(rejected_consume.status, 409)
        final_hold = self.client.call("GET", f"/holds/{hold_id}")
        final_quota = self.client.call("GET", "/quota")
        self.assertEqual(final_hold.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(final_quota.status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(final_hold.body, replayed_hold.body)
        self.assertEqual(final_quota.body, replayed_quota.body)
        self.assertEqual(
            final_quota.body["available"] + final_quota.body["consumed"],
            4,
        )
